entities.summary: Justin Jamel Wright–Foreman is an American professional basketball player for Casademont Zaragoza of the Liga ACB and the Europe Cup. He played college basketball for the Hofstra Pride. He was drafted by the Utah Jazz with the 53rd overall pick in the 2019 NBA draft.
